description: From PR #110 gating audit (pre-existing): IndexUpdate.extract_keys_in_range uses key <= end_key (inclusive) and page_entirely_after_range? has the matching > vs >=, though clear_range is exclusive-end in Tx, Metadata, and RoutingData. A key exactly at end_key is wrongly cleared. No system key sits at a strinc boundary today, but user-data clear_ranges hit this. Align olivine to exclusive-end with boundary tests. Also (same audit, minor): bootstrap read range end uses prefix<>0xFFFFFFFF instead of strinc (over-wide, safe); RoutingData insert_log lacks dedupe on repeated sets (theoretical).

comments.text: Audit 2026-08-20: the two side notes at the end are resolved by the trim campaign - RoutingData.insert_log is now idempotent by id (dedupe concern gone), and RoutingData was rewritten as immutable gb_trees. The main olivine inclusive-end bug is untouched by the Phase B work and stands as written.

title: Olivine clear_range uses inclusive end-key; everywhere else is exclusive
